english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for considering A to be B.
Use this construction when regarding A as B, rather than simply looking at A.
Use this when explicitly regarding or treating A as being B.

examples.english: We regard him as one of our own.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dong1 keoi5 hai6 zi6 gei2 jan4

examples.english: I view him as one of my own.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dong1 keoi5 hai6 zi6 gei2 jan4

examples.english: We deem him one of our own.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dong1 keoi5 hai6 zi6 gei2 jan4

english.note: Use this conversational construction when treating A as if it were B for the purpose of an argument or calculation.

examples.english: You can presuppose that this plot is a park and work out how many seats are needed.
examples.traditional: 你可以當呢塊地係公園，先計吓要幾多個座位。
